items.title: Asm-built bare-metal OS boots Qwen3-0.6B in 24 KB and beats llama.cpp CPU decode by 31 to 54 percent
items.summary: A from-scratch x86-64 assembly Multiboot kernel maps Q8_0 Qwen3-0.6B weights from RAM and serves multi-turn chat with no Linux or libc; on one EPYC 7642 the author reports 23.7 to 134.9 tok/s versus 16.6 to 103.0 for llama.cpp, with bit-exact greedy output against PyTorch. MIT source and an ISO builder are public.

doubt.pushback: Single-author benchmark on one CPU, not yet reproduced; one reply argues a trimmed Linux kernel would get most of the gain.

reception.summary: Mostly amazement and requests for a plain explanation; a few note it could run on clusters or a Raspberry Pi, nobody posted their own numbers yet.

items.title: Karpathy has Claude Opus 5.5 build a Civilization-style US map from 31 public data sources in one 7-hour run
items.summary: Using the Claude Code desktop app with Opus 5.5, one long agent session pulled and reconciled Census, BEA, BLS, NOAA, USGS and other datasets onto a 25 km hex grid and shipped a deployed, browsable game-style map with 19 lenses and county explorer, about 45K lines of code. Shows long-horizon data engineering by a coding agent with a public result and source.

reception.summary: Replies praise the data reconciliation work and ask how sources that disagree were handled and how drift was avoided over 7 hours; several joke about usage quotas; one notes the source is an MIT zip.

items.title: OpenCode adds a video generation tool for providers with video models, Grok Imagine and Gemini Omni in Console
items.summary: The open-source coding agent can now call video models as a tool when a connected provider offers them, so an agent session can produce clips such as launch videos alongside code; OpenCode Console users get Grok Imagine and Gemini Omni.

reception.summary: Mostly enthusiasm; the substantive questions are whether the agent can review its own clip and re-prompt, pricing, and quality or length limits.

items.title: SemiAnalysis GDPx leaderboard: GPT-6.2 Astra leads at 19.3 percent, Claude Fable 5.2 16.4, Gemini 4 Neon 6th at 10.1
items.summary: SemiAnalysis published GDPx results on economically valuable task suites: Astra tops the overall score while Fable 5.2 leads the software engineering slice (24.4 vs 13.3), and Sol lands near Opus 5.5 at a fraction of the per-task cost.

doubt.pushback: Repliers say Neon's low coding score may reflect the Antigravity harness rather than the model, and that a 2.9-point lead needs run-to-run variance; SemiAnalysis says it runs the harnesses itself.

reception.summary: Interest in a non-coding economic benchmark, skepticism about harness effects and missing variance, and debate over Neon placing 6th.

items.title: Six Easy Tasks: real-world robot benchmark where frontier coding agents score 0 of 72 trials and teleoperators 100 percent
items.summary: Robocurve's SET asks GPT-6.2 Astra (Codex) and Claude Fable 5.2 (Claude Code) to drive real robot arms through six household manipulations such as capping a bottle or unlocking a padlock; both failed every trial while human teleoperators on the same arms finished all six.

items.title: Sand AI's MAGI-2 (480B, 28B active) debuts #1 on Artificial Analysis image-to-video at 0.08 dollars per second
items.summary: Artificial Analysis ranks MAGI-2 statistically tied for first in image-to-video and 7th in text-to-video; it generates up to 30 s of 1080p audio-video with up to 20 reference items, about 7x cheaper than Seedance 2.5. Proprietary API now, with open-source releases stated as intended.

items.title: Ollama v0.40.18 runs Inkling 2 Mini on Windows and Linux and adds custom Mac kernels
items.summary: Thinking Machines' 26B (5.4B active) open model now runs locally through Ollama on Windows and Linux with 32 GB of memory or VRAM, with faster Mac performance from custom kernels; Fireworks also began hosting Inkling 2 Small and Mini.

items.title: Hermes Agent adds hermes fallback: in-place provider and model failover mid-session
items.summary: A configurable backup chain swaps a running Hermes Agent session to the next provider and model on rate limits, 5xx errors, auth failures or dropped connections, across CLI, messaging gateways, desktop and cron jobs; a check command validates each backup and its credentials.

items.title: You.com, NVIDIA and CoreWeave post-train Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for web research: BrowseComp 37.0 to 45.5 percent
items.summary: Three weeks of SFT and RL rollouts with You.com Search lifted the small Nemotron model's BrowseComp accuracy by about 8.5 points while cutting tool calls per task by 30 percent.

doubt.pushback: Partner-reported result with no linked write-up in the post.

items.title: NeoWorld-10K v0.1: 1,324 articulated, simulation-checked 3D household assets under CC BY 4.0
items.summary: A dataset of editable objects with part structure, joints, axes, limits and kinematic trees, shipped as GLB, USDZ, URDF and Blender sources, for articulated-object reconstruction and embodied AI simulation.

items.title: Wide-verify patch speeds NVFP4-KV Qwen3.8 Flash-Next decode 31 to 50 percent at 6 to 16 streams on one RTX PRO 6000
items.summary: Extending SGLang fast paths from 16 to 64 rows stops speculative-decoding verification from falling onto slow kernels past four concurrent streams; per-step time drops from 25.2 to 18.4 ms at 5 streams and 46.6 to 32.9 ms at 16, with code and full data published.

items.title: Nace AI ships Drex Max v1.2, one multimodal checkpoint for general and financial decisions at 0.04 dollars per 1M tokens
items.summary: Drex Max and Drex for Finance merge into one model returning probabilities for every option in a single pass; Nace reports 79.0 percent on OSWorld-Verified and 97.1 on BFCL, available through its API.

doubt.pushback: Vendor-reported benchmark wins with no independent run linked.

items.title: InclusionAI LingSante MedGuard: medical risk guardrail models, 27B reaches F1 87.4 across 11 detection tasks
items.summary: A guardrail model family aimed at subtle clinical errors (wrong lab rows, misapplied guidelines, confident false conclusions); the 4B variant scores 82.3 F1 on the lab's MedGuardBench, above a 397B general base model.

doubt.pushback: Scored on the lab's own benchmark; no weights link in the post.

items.title: Google requires AI agents to reach Gmail, Drive and Calendar through Workspace MCP or the Workspace CLI from Feb 1 2027
items.summary: Google's new Workspace AI Tools Addendum says tools driven by an AI agent or model must use Google-hosted MCP servers instead of calling Workspace REST APIs; from Feb 1 2027 agents on REST are capped at Standard Tier quotas, and Scaled Tier billing starts Apr 1 2027.
